name: web-white-card-management-landing-with-floating-card-and-laurel
title: Card Management Hero with Floating Card
whatItIs: A white hero with a two-tone headline where 'Card Management.' is in bold italic serif, a subline, a vertical icon rail with a Home pill on the left, a tilted gradient Visa card floating with a soft shadow, a floating caption, a #1 laurel and project metadata at the bottom.
whatItMeans: A single floating card on white feels elegant, and small labels and rail add a sense of a real product.
techniques: Italic serif emphasis inside a light sans headline
Single tilted 3D object as the hero
Vertical icon rail with a highlighted item
Metadata row of project details at the base

vocabulary.definition: One object rendered large as the focus of a hero.
A vertical strip of navigation icons.
Labels listing name, category, designer and date.
